scope: private finite process-group diagnostic; controls and untimed smoke passed, bounded paired representative workload measurement permitted through controller phase gate

campaign.supersedes: failed first timed attempt in results-group/pair-1-fresh; preserved as a pre-test driver-constructor failure, not benchmark evidence
campaign.phase_gate: Only append controls-complete PASS after error control, cancellation control, fresh smoke (6 tasks/90 cases), and resident smoke (6 tasks/90 cases) all pass. The controller measure phase remains prohibited under this admission.

expected_behavior.error_control: PASS: expected poison failure followed by clean same-process probe, same lease and source closure, with restoration and lease release
expected_behavior.cancel_control: PASS only if both recorded PID/start identities are absent before fallback, no fallback signals are sent, cancellation is observed, and lease is released
expected_behavior.smoke_fresh: PASS: six tasks alternate agentdocs/topology for 90 expected cases, each in a fresh process and lease
expected_behavior.smoke_resident: PASS: identical six-task/90-case payload in one process and lease
expected_behavior.smoke_scope: Smoke samples may carry elapsed fields in raw receipts but are diagnostic only and must not be used as paired timing evidence or a performance claim

review.binding: Independent readback verified all 535 build-binding file entries by size and SHA-256; no mismatches; build-3 returned 0 and is bound to the exact worker binary and overlay.
review.source_fix: ReceiptResult.__init__(stream=None, descriptions=None, verbosity=None) matches the actual unittest.TestResult/TextTestRunner resultClass call signature.
review.smoke_timing: Controller run() also records elapsed fields for smoke invocations. They are not paired schedule measurements and must be excluded from performance analysis.
review.scope_limit: Private finite diagnostic for trusted cooperative process groups; not OS sandbox, persistent worker, shipping RCC, Actions acceptance, or broad release qualification.
review.measurement_gate: Controller measure phase requires the final controls-complete PASS in results-group-2/controller.jsonl; no reuse of prior failed or timed campaign evidence.

control_evidence.test_id_counts: All 5 agentdocs and 25 topology test IDs per corresponding task unique within task, all PASS; source bytes unchanged per task.
control_evidence.guards: All four invocations rc0, no stop/live identities, strict pre/post owned mode guards 0700 and global 0750.
control_evidence.cleanup: Two cancel PID/start identities absent before and after fallback; zero fallback signals. All homes reported released leases and had no lease JSON. Task directories retained logs only; temporary task dirs were cleaned.
control_evidence.smoke_elapsed: Raw elapsed fields exist for smoke invocations but are not comparison samples and are excluded from any performance inference.

limits: Prior first timed attempt remains a failed setup/test-driver execution with zero test cases; do not treat it as a benchmark sample or include it in comparisons.
Smoke-control elapsed fields are diagnostic only and cannot support a performance claim.
The finite process-group prototype only addresses cooperative descendants that remain in the process group; it is not a containment boundary.
No shipping RCC, Actions, persistent-worker, OS-sandbox, or broad release qualification is claimed.

The only measurement authorized is the newly scheduled bounded counterbalanced paired workload via the controller measure phase after its controls-complete gate; previous failed attempt and smoke-control elapsed fields are not measurement samples.
